# PrivateNote.ai

**Share secrets. Leave no trail.**

End-to-end encrypted notes and file attachments — encrypted in your browser before upload.

🌐 [privatenote.ai](https://privatenote.ai) · 📦 [Source & extensions](https://github.com/privatenote-ai/privatenote-ai)

## What we build

- Encrypted disappearing notes (read-once, expiry, optional password)
- Encrypted file attachments (ciphertext only on server)
- Chrome, VS Code/Cursor, CLI, MCP, and Codex developer tools

## Repositories

| Repo | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [privatenote-ai](https://github.com/privatenote-ai/privatenote-ai) | Extensions + shared crypto utilities |

## Security

Report vulnerabilities to **security@privatenote.ai**. See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/privatenote-ai/privatenote-ai/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
